checks: Every stage receives and checks expected package manifest SHA256 and source commit/tree.

Original base/race exercise functions assert semantic behavior, expected denials, recovery/epoch conditions and no retained handles before returning.
Fault stage requires exact SIGSEGV and fixed entry marker, rejecting an earlier load error.
Timeout sends SIGKILL to the owned process group and bounds post-kill communicate to two seconds.

mode: read-only static review; no source edits, tests, compilation or native execution by reviewer
original_desktop_optimize_observation: Not retroactively inferred. One same-package v2 functional execution with explicit flags is a targeted way to obtain the missing observation without rebuilding or rerunning performance.
remaining_record_check: Compare registration/final runner identities to externally pinned v2 runner SHA; the reviewed diff stored both identities but did not itself include their equality in passed. External readback can supply this check.
scope: Same committed Python and desktop-built shared objects on a second Linux x86-64 host only.
No target-host compiler qualification, new ISA, all-schedules coverage, device/MMIO/DMA guarantee, general concurrency theorem, or performance advantage.
Detached descendants and kernel uninterruptible states are outside the narrow process-group cleanup argument.
